executiveSummary: CISA/NSA/FBI/DOE/EPA warn of active campaigns targeting Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-generated scripts and S7comm tooling; immediate network isolation and S7 hardening are required. Security Advisory Joint U.S. advisory attributes ongoing exploitation of PLCs (Rockwell/Schneider/Siemens) in Water/Wastewater, Energy, and Government sectors to Iranian-affiliated actors, with logic tampering and alarm suppression observed. Security Advisory SonicWall SMA 1000 remote access gateways are under active exploitation via a pre-auth SSRF (CVSS 10) chained to post-auth command injection; patch to platform-hotfix 12.4.3-03526 / 12.5.0-02952 and hunt for IoCs before trusting the device. View Article CISA added seven new Known Exploited Vulnerabilities affecting Starlette, Kestra OSS, JFrog Artifactory, BerriAI LiteLLM, Sangoma Switchvox, and SonicWall SMA1000; rapid remediation and compromise assessment are directed under BOD 26-04. CISA KEV NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) has a public PoC; appliances are widely used for remote access and SSO bridges-immediate patching and exposure reduction are advised. Advisory OPC UA server stack (Eclipse Milo) multiple flaws enable remote info disclosure/DoS and authorization bypass against ICS endpoints; operators should enforce Sign&Encrypt, disable anonymous access, and upgrade promptly. CISA Bulletin Rockwell advisories this cycle include PLC Major Nonrecoverable Fault (MNRF) DoS conditions and workstation-tool privilege escalations affecting engineering hosts; patch firmware/tools and enforce CIP-aware filtering. Logix Platform RSLinx Classic State-sponsored exploitation of backbone/edge routers continues (PRC and Russian nexus), leveraging SNMP/TFTP misconfigurations and Smart Install/IOS XE flaws to stage access and harvest credentials; tighten router hygiene and management isolation. Supporting Report Supporting Report #StopRansomware: Gunra RaaS actively abuses Fortinet edge CVEs and common post-compromise tooling (Impacket/Sliver), underscoring the need to harden VPN/VDI and maintain offline, immutable backups. Security Advisory

relevance: Multiple, independently sourced government advisories confirm active adversary interest in programmable logic controllers and their support ecosystems. The most material risks this cycle are (1) direct PLC targeting and logic manipulation (Siemens S7 family; multi-vendor logic tampering), (2) perimeter gateway zero-days actively exploited (SonicWall SMA1000; NetScaler ADC/GW PoC), and (3) exploited enterprise and AI/dev platforms in the KEV catalog that can offer initial access and identity abuse paths into OT/DMZs. Several OT vendor advisories (Rockwell, Mitsubishi Electric) additionally indicate process disruption potential via controller DoS or workstation-tool privilege escalation. Combined, these trends elevate near-term operational risk-especially for Water/Wastewater, Energy, Critical Manufacturing, and Transportation operators.

descriptions: Edge exploitation/Zero-days: SSRF→RCE chains against VPN/remote access gateways (SonicWall SMA1000) [ATT&CK T1190, T1210].
Router compromise and credential harvesting (SNMP/TFTP/Smart Install/IOS XE; PRC/RU ops) [T1046, T1552, T1041].
ICS protocol abuse: S7comm PUT/GET reads/writes; CIP malformed frames causing PLC MNRF DoS [ICS: T0865, T0814].
Living-off-the-land post-compromise: Impacket/Sliver, WMI/SMB/RDP for lateral movement [T1021, T1047].
Supply-chain/Server-side components: OPC UA server stack (Eclipse Milo) auth/DoS conditions affecting OT data flows [T0819].

outlook72h: Immediate: Isolate/patch SonicWall SMA1000 fleet; block public access to WorkPlace/AMC; rotate credentials/TOTP; assess for SSRF-originated internal abuse. Immediate: Remove any PLC/HMI internet exposure; enable emergency monitoring for S7comm/CIP anomalies; verify logic and alarm states. Within 48h: Apply KEV-listed fixes (Starlette, Kestra, Artifactory, LiteLLM, Sangoma, SonicWall); check for pre-patch compromise; tighten reverse proxy normalization. Within 72h: Audit routers/firewalls for SNMP/Smart Install/TFTP exposure; implement SNMPv3 and ACLs; centralize and retain config/change logs.
